initialExam.title: UPSC Engineering Services (ESE) 2026
initialExam.description: Engineering Services Examination for Group A posts in Railways, PWD, Telecom. Prelims 8 Feb 2026 (result out 26 Feb); Mains 21 Jun 2026 (completed).
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech degree in relevant engineering branch
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS + Engineering Aptitude, Technical paper. Mains: Two conventional engineering papers. Interview: Personality Test.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers (500 marks). Mains: 2 conventional papers (600 marks). Interview: 200 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Group A engineering posts in Indian Railway Service, Central Engineering Service, Indian Telecom Service, etc.
initialExam.careerGrowth: AEE → EE → SE → CE → Chief Engineer through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form with engineering details 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Medical, Pension, LTC
